title: Hornwort DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Eftychis Frangedakis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p27dqhn

steps.title: Grind tissue and transfer
steps.instruction: Grind 0.5–2 g of hornwort tissue with a mortar and pestle in liquid nitrogen until finely ground, then transfer the frozen ground tissue to a 30 mL tube.

steps.title: Add extraction buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of extraction buffer pre‑warmed to 60 °C, 100 mg of PVP‑40 per gram of tissue, and 5 µL RNase A (100 mg/mL) to the tube; mix by inversion and incubate in a 60 °C water bath for 30 min.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 mg PVP‑40 per gram tissue.

steps.title: Add chloroform‑IAA and emulsify
steps.instruction: Add 12 mL of chloroform:IAA (24:1) to the mixture and mix by inversion until an emulsion forms.

steps.title: Centrifuge first extraction
steps.instruction: Spin the emulsion at 10,000 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 30 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Second chloroform extraction and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Repeat the chloroform:IAA extraction to remove cloudiness (PVP) by adding chloroform:IAA (same volume as before), mixing to form an emulsion, then spin at 7,000 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add chloroform:IAA (24:1) – same volume as previous addition.
Mix by inversion to form emulsion.
Spin at 7,000 rpm for 10 min at RT.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with NaCl and ethanol
steps.instruction: To the recovered aqueous solution, add ½ volume of 5 M NaCl, mix well, then add two volumes of cold (‑20 °C) 95 % ethanol, invert to mix, place the tube in a ‑20 °C freezer for 10 min, and finally spin at 13,000 rpm for 15 min.

steps.title: Optional TE resuspension and repeat extraction
steps.instruction: If desired, resuspend the pellet in 2 mL TE buffer and repeat step 7 (second chloroform extraction and centrifugation).

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70% ethanol
steps.instruction: Pour off the supernatant, wash the pellet with cold (0–4 °C) 70 % v/v ethanol, spin at 13,000 rpm for 5 min, discard supernatant, and air‑dry the pellet for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: Add cold 0–4 °C 70 % ethanol to wash pellet.

steps.title: Dissolve DNA in TE and store
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried pellet in 50 µL TE buffer, incubate preferably overnight at 4 °C, then transfer the solution to a 1.5 mL tube.
